raw_response:
I've been working these 4 mu for fifty years, since I was thirteen. Me and my old man, we do it all ourselves. Can't hire help — no money for that, and anyhow nobody around here works for cheap anymore.

The wheat goes in early October, same as always, when the ginkgo leaves start falling. I save my own seed, the fat grains from last year, mix a little pink medicine and plant. Before planting, I hire the small tractor to rotary-till the field, and I spread about eighty jin of compound fertilizer per mu — that's most of a bag. I put it down right before the tractor goes through so it mixes in. Come spring, when the wheat turns green, if it looks yellow I'll topdress with about forty jin of urea. Last year I did that and it was fine, so I'll do the same. Water is expensive — the pump eats electricity — but you can't skip it: once after planting so it sprouts, once at jointing when it's growing fast, and once at grain-filling if the sky doesn't give rain. Three times, usually.

Maize is right after wheat harvest in early June. No time to rest — cut the wheat today, plant corn tomorrow. The window is tight, maybe five days. I buy hybrid seed from Old Zhang's shop in the village, about three or four jin per mu, costs me around forty-five yuan. You can't save maize seed, it doesn't breed true. I put compound fertilizer in the furrow when planting, another eighty jin per mu. At the big trumpet leaf stage, if it's dry I'll throw on twenty jin of urea and water once. Maybe water twice total for maize, that's enough if the summer rains come.

I spray herbicide once for each crop — that's it. For insects, only if I see them in the field. Can't waste money on what isn't there.

Last year wheat gave about 350 kg per mu. This year I hope for the same, maybe a bit more if the spring rains are good. Maize usually gives around 400 kg per mu. My neighbor down the road, his son bought him some fancy fertilizer and he got 500, but I can't afford that. We spend about two thousand yuan on the whole year — that's money we scraped together. Can't spend more, but if I spend less, the yield drops and we go hungry.
